day4_night_start.name: Me
day4_night_start.text: *I'm back home. Lying in my room, today's memories flicker past like a film reel.*

wall_seo_1.name: Me
wall_seo_1.text: *10 PM. A call from Seoyeon. There's no laughter in her voice.*

wall_seo_2.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_2.text: "Can you come out right now? The park. — Sorry, it's sudden."

wall_seo_3.name: Me
wall_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon is sitting on a park bench. Her eyes are red.*

wall_seo_6.name: Me
wall_seo_6.text: *I sit beside her. Seoyeon is staring straight ahead. For a long time.*

wall_seo_9.name: Me
wall_seo_9.text: *Seoyeon smiles. — It's not her usual composed smile. It's a smile for self-defense.*

wall_seo_10.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_10.text: "Our house looks fine from the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president daughter. But Mom and Dad have been strangers under the same roof for a year. They just haven't filed the divorce papers."

wall_seo_11.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_11.text: "Mom told me, 'At least you have to be perfect to hold this family together.'"

wall_seo_12.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_12.text: "I was ten. — She said that to a ten-year-old."

wall_seo_13.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_13.text: "That's when I started practicing smiling in the mirror. The angle to lift my lips, the timing to crinkle my eyes."

wall_seo_14.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_14.text: "Every time I got praised, I thought, 'This smile was practiced too — has anyone ever seen the real me?'"

wall_seo_15.name: Me
wall_seo_15.text: *Seoyeon stopped talking. Her lips are trembling. — And slowly, very slowly, the expression she'd been maintaining so perfectly crumbled. Tears stream down her face. Silently.*

wall_seo_hug_choice.name: Me
wall_seo_hug_choice.text: *Seoyeon is crying. I've never seen her like this.*

wall_seo_hug_2.name: Me
wall_seo_hug_2.text: *Seoyeon buried her face in my chest. Her small shoulders are shaking.*

wall_seo_hug_3.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_hug_3.text: "...Crying in front of someone — this is the first time since elementary school. Eight years. — All that time, I only cried alone in the bathroom."

wall_seo_pinky_2.name: Me
wall_seo_pinky_2.text: "I promise. When you want to cry, you can cry in front of me."

wall_seo_pinky_4.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_pinky_4.text: "...Why are you like this. Why do you — make promises so easily."

wall_seo_line_choice.name: Me
wall_seo_line_choice.text: *Seoyeon is wiping her tears, looking up at me with trembling eyes.*
choices: "I like this Seoyeon more than the perfect one."
"You're not the student council president to me — you're just Seoyeon, my girlfriend."
"Honestly, I thought you were flawless. But thank you for showing me this side of you."

wall_seo_after_line_2.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_after_line_2.text: "This face — it's a mess right now, isn't it? Makeup smeared, eyes swollen. — Is this really okay?"

wall_seo_after_line_4.name: Me
wall_seo_after_line_4.text: *Seoyeon smiles. An unpracticed smile. — Her makeup is smeared, her eyes are swollen, and yet this is the most beautiful smile.*

wall_seo_after_line_5.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
wall_seo_after_line_5.text: "For the first time in eight years, I think my unpracticed face might be okay."

wall_seo_glimpse_1.name: Me
wall_seo_glimpse_1.text: *Walking home after seeing Seoyeon to her door. — I pass by the school.*

wall_seo_glimpse_2.name: Me
wall_seo_glimpse_2.text: *There's a light on in the gym window. Emergency lights. Someone is bouncing a ball alone. — I can faintly make out the jersey number. It's Dain.*

wall_seo_glimpse_3.name: Me
wall_seo_glimpse_3.text: *...Alone in the gym at 11 PM? She didn't contact me today.*

wall_seo_glimpse_4.name: Me
wall_seo_glimpse_4.text: *I paused for a moment — then kept walking. Tonight belongs to Seoyeon. But my feet feel heavy.*

wall_dain_3.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_3.text: "Just come lol! I left the gym back door open!"

wall_dain_4.name: Me
wall_dain_4.text: *The dark gym, lit only by emergency lights. Dain is bouncing a volleyball alone. She's smiling harder than usual.*

wall_dain_6.name: Me
wall_dain_6.text: "Why are you at school at night?"

wall_dain_9.name: Me
wall_dain_9.text: *I toss the set. Dain leaps up — spikes it. The moment she lands — she grabs her right knee and crouches down.*

wall_dain_10.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_10.text: "No, it's fine!! I just twisted it a bit lol, it's noth—"

wall_dain_11.name: Me
wall_dain_11.text: *Her hand gripping her knee has gone white. — It's not nothing.*

wall_dain_13.name: Me
wall_dain_13.text: *I sit beside her without a word. Dain's mouth closes. A long silence.*

wall_dain_16.name: Me
wall_dain_16.text: *Dain is making a face I've never seen before. Dain, not smiling.*

wall_dain_17.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_17.text: "I had surgery, and the doctor — he was really careful about how he put it. 'Daily life will be fine, but playing like before...' — I don't remember what came after. Everything went silent."

wall_dain_18.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_18.text: "Athletic scholarship. Pro league. National team. — Since I was five, that was all I had. And it ended in one sentence."

wall_dain_19.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_19.text: "I didn't tell anyone. Not even my parents. 'Dain wouldn't be Dain if she couldn't play!' — I didn't want to hear that."

wall_dain_20.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_20.text: "Every time someone at school said 'You're so full of energy!' — right here. ...I felt like dying."

wall_dain_21.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_21.text: "Today too. Running around on our date. Pretending to be cheerful next to you. My knee was screaming."

wall_dain_22.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_22.text: "— But if I show you I'm hurting too, then I have nothing left."

wall_dain_choice.name: Me
wall_dain_choice.text: *Dain is clutching the volleyball, head down. Her shoulders are trembling.*
choices: "Volleyball isn't your only dream, Dain. Let's find a new one together."
"You can cry. You don't have to pretend to be cheerful. Not with me."
"...Want me to set one more? One last time."

wall_dain_newdream_2.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_newdream_2.text: "...Like coaching, or training. I do like teaching."

wall_dain_newdream_3.name: Me
wall_dain_newdream_3.text: "You'd be the most passionate coach in the world."

wall_dain_newdream_4.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_newdream_4.text: "...Idiot, if you say stuff like that I'll cry..."

wall_dain_cry_1.name: Me
wall_dain_cry_1.text: *Dain collapsed onto the court. She started crying, hugging the volleyball.*

wall_dain_cry_2.name: Me
wall_dain_cry_2.text: *As if a year's worth of held-back tears burst out at once. The sound of sobbing echoes through the empty gym.*

wall_dain_cry_3.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_cry_3.text: "All alone... wrapping my knee in bandages every morning..."

wall_dain_cry_4.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_cry_4.text: "I put it in my phone alarm. 'Smile today!!' it says..."

wall_dain_cry_5.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_cry_5.text: "Every morning I'd see that... see those two exclamation marks... and force my lips into a smile..."

wall_dain_cry_6.name: Me
wall_dain_cry_6.text: *She put two exclamation marks in that alarm note — because one wasn't enough to fool even herself.*

wall_dain_lastspike_2.name: Me
wall_dain_lastspike_2.text: *Dain clenched her jaw and leapt — the perfect spike. The ball slams into the court.*

wall_dain_lastspike_3.name: Me
wall_dain_lastspike_3.text: *She grabbed her knee on landing — but she's smiling.*

wall_dain_lastspike_4.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_lastspike_4.text: "...Heh. It hurts. But it feels oddly refreshing. — I'm glad my last hit on this court was a set from {name}."

wall_dain_lastspike_6.name: 다인(Dain)
wall_dain_lastspike_6.text: "— Thirteen years since I was five. Thank you."

wall_dain_farewell_1.name: Me
wall_dain_farewell_1.text: *A sentence from Dain with no exclamation marks at all. — That itself is the weight of farewell.*

wall_dain_farewell_2.name: Me
wall_dain_farewell_2.text: *I leave the gym with Dain. We pass by the back gate of the school.*

wall_dain_glimpse_1.name: Me
wall_dain_glimpse_1.text: *I see a light in the library annex window. A small desk lamp.*

wall_dain_glimpse_2.name: Me
wall_dain_glimpse_2.text: *It's Yuna. Sitting alone. Whether she's reading or just sitting there — I can't tell from here.*

wall_dain_glimpse_3.name: Me
wall_dain_glimpse_3.text: *Yuna didn't message me today. — Yuna never texts. Whether that's normal or just today — I don't know.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4.name: Me
wall_dain_glimpse_4.text: *I pretended not to see. — But why does my heart feel like this.*

wall_yuna_1.name: Me
wall_yuna_1.text: *10 PM. A message from Yuna. 'School back gate. Come now.'*

wall_yuna_2.name: Me
wall_yuna_2.text: *The school at night feels like a different place. Yuna is standing by the back gate. She looks more — uneasy than usual.*

wall_yuna_4.name: Me
wall_yuna_4.text: *Yuna heads toward the library annex. Past her secret reading spot — deeper in. The basement archives.*

wall_yuna_5.name: Me
wall_yuna_5.text: *Between dusty shelves. Yuna pulls out an old envelope.*

wall_yuna_6.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_6.text: "This. I got it a year ago."

wall_yuna_7.name: Me
wall_yuna_7.text: *A letter inside the envelope. — 'To Yuna. I'm sorry. I have to leave for reasons I can't explain. — Junho Lee'*

wall_yuna_9.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_9.text: "A senior who used to come here with me. — The only person I was ever close to."

wall_yuna_10.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_10.text: "In middle school, I was invisible. Nobody in class talked to me."

wall_yuna_11.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_11.text: "He was the first. 'I liked your writing' — those words. To me, that was proof I existed."

wall_yuna_12.name: Me
wall_yuna_12.text: *Yuna's voice is shaking. — Her sentences are much longer than usual.*

wall_yuna_13.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_13.text: "One day he transferred. No contact. Just this letter."

wall_yuna_14.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_14.text: "The person who proved I existed — disappeared. I felt like I'd become invisible again."

wall_yuna_15.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_15.text: "When you first came to the library. You had a similar vibe to him. — That's why I was scared. If I got close again, you might vanish too."

wall_yuna_16.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_16.text: "But you came every day. Quietly. — Without disappearing."

wall_yuna_choice.name: Me
wall_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna's eyes are glistening. — This is the first time I've heard her talk this much.*
choices: "I'm not that senior. I'm me. But I'll still stay by your side."
"I'm okay being his stand-in. I want to be the person you need."
"...So you approached me because of him? As a replacement?"

wall_yuna_moved_1.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_moved_1.text: "...At first, maybe I was chasing his shadow."

wall_yuna_moved_3.name: Me
wall_yuna_moved_3.text: *Yuna lifts her head. Those aren't her usual drowsy eyes. She's looking at me directly, unwavering.*

wall_yuna_moved_5.name: Me
wall_yuna_moved_5.text: *Yuna said four sentences in a row. — That's as good as a confession.*

wall_yuna_sub_1.name: 유나(Yuna)
wall_yuna_sub_1.text: "...Idiot. You're not a stand-in. You're already more than enough as yourself."

wall_yuna_reject_3.name: Me
wall_yuna_reject_3.text: *Yuna turns away. Her shoulders are trembling.*

wall_yuna_reject_4.name: Me
wall_yuna_reject_4.text: *That was the worst choice. — I can hear Yuna's wall closing shut again.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_1.name: Me
wall_yuna_glimpse_1.text: *I leave the school, leaving Yuna behind. Passing the front gate.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_2.name: Me
wall_yuna_glimpse_2.text: *Under the streetlight by the school gate. Seoyeon is standing there. — No, she was standing there. Holding her phone, typing something, then deleting it. Typing, then deleting.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3.name: Me
wall_yuna_glimpse_3.text: *I don't know who she's trying to text. — Actually, I think I do.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_4.name: Me
wall_yuna_glimpse_4.text: *Seoyeon puts her phone in her pocket and turns around. Her back is straight. Perfectly so. — Night comes for the ones you didn't choose too. And she's spending that night alone.*

day4_night_regret.name: Me
day4_night_regret.text: *...I could have said it today. Under that sunset, it was the perfect moment.*

day4_night_regret_2.name: Me
day4_night_regret_2.text: *It's okay. There's tomorrow. Tomorrow, for sure.*

day4_night_regret_msg.name: Me
day4_night_regret_msg.text: *A message on my phone. "I had fun today. Are you free tomorrow too?"*

day4_night_regret_reply.name: Me
day4_night_regret_reply.text: *"Yeah, let's meet tomorrow too." Tomorrow, I'll definitely say it.*

day4_night_reflect.name: Me
day4_night_reflect.text: *Saturday passed just like that. What will tomorrow bring.*

day4_night_sleep.name: Me
day4_night_sleep.text: *When I close my eyes, that person's face appears. I wouldn't mind falling asleep like this.*

day4_final.name: Me
day4_final.text: *Saturday night deepens. Tomorrow is Sunday — the last day.*
